Outstanding Cantonese Dim Sum
Nov 2022
Cantonese dim sum is one of my favorite meals and Shang Palace has some of the best that we have ever tasted. Two of us strolled around District 1 in search of Shang Palace based on reviews and it did not disappoint.
Our visit was on a Wednesday at 11:00A and we were the first table on this day. The servers were very attentive, polished and professional. I was also very fortunate that our server spoke Chinese (Cantonese) as neither of us speak Vietnamese. They also can communicate in English too!
The level of service was impressive. As an example, they pour the tea for you at the table throughout the meal.
The dim sum was hot, fresh and the ingredients were very "clean." The pace of the food delivery to the table was perfect. It allowed us to enjoy each item while they were hot.
The exterior of the deep-fried pork & dried shrimp glutinous rice flour dumplings (hom sui gok) was crispy and the interior soft and sweet. And the steam soup dumplings (sui luhng bao) were tender and flavorful with a great balance of soup and filling.
The pan-fried chive & prawn dumplings and the pan-fried pork buns offered great textures and flavors too! 
There's nothing like fresh shrimp rice rolls (har cheung) with its soft, thin rice noodles or hand-made steam siu mai.
I find it interesting that some reviews state that Shang Palace is pricey and that the value rating is 3.5 dots. Everything is relative and I feel that Shang Palace is a great value with exceptional dim sum. For the 6-items and tea, our check was $25USD.
We will certainly be back for dim sum and other meals when we return to HCMC.

The BEST dim sum
Aug 2019 • Couples
We are retirees from the Western Hemisphere who are traveling in SE Asia for 6 months. We have eaten dim sum in NYC, San Francisco, Los Angelas, Washington,DC (and suburbs), Baltimore, Texas and elsewhere in the US as well as Mexico, Panama, Singapore, Bangkok and here and we have never had such good dim sum. Everything we ordered arrived piping hot and everything tasted fresh and homemade rather than bulk/machine made. Service was impeccable and we will enjoy it later today as well because we ordered enough to have extra to take away. This was the smartest decision we’ve made this week if not this month. Delicious and we will return.
